violations.why: ISR sets the variable to 50 between the loop init write and the condition read, so the loop sees a value main did not write.
ISR changes the index after the condition check, so the array index used differs from the one checked.
The increment is a non-atomic read-modify-write, so the ISR write is overwritten by the stale incremented value.
ISR overwrites the incremented value before the loop condition reads it.
ISR changes the variable between the index read and the increment read, so the increment starts from a different value.
